_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. Glorify's two public surfaces declare separate vocabularies on :root (raw/css-vars.json): core.* carries the marketing site's hashed Framer --token-* declarations, app.* carries the SPA's own semantic vocabulary (--light-*/--dark-*/--neutral-light-*/--active-*/--field-*/the accent ramps/--glori-gradient) that the signed-out auth cards and the anonymous editor paint. Measured roles alias to the declared values they match, inside their own surface set.
